te: After a two-year siege, the city of Toledo, in Spain, surrenders to the forces of the Caliph of Córdoba Abd al-Rahman I…
dz: 经过两年的围攻后,西班牙的托莱多城向科尔多瓦·阿卜德·拉赫曼三世的卡利夫部队投降,假定他在征服中行军的战役中取得了重要的胜利.
de: After a two-year siege, the city of Toledo, in Spain, surrenders to the forces of the Caliph of Córdoba Abd al-Rahman III, assuming an important victory in his campaign to subjugate the Central March.

dz: Abbasid Caliph al-Muqtadir在与Mu'nis al-Muzaffar将军的部队作战时被击毙。 穆克塔迪尔的弟弟卡希尔被选中继任.
de: Abbasid caliph al-Muqtadir is killed while fighting against the forces of general Mu'nis al-Muzaffar. Al-Muqtadir's brother al-Qahir is chosen to succeed him.
